construction: Let psi be the exact monotone DNF for 4-CLIQUE.
Choose seven edges E inside a 3-colorable graph C_f.
Let T_E be the conjunction of the seven corresponding edge variables.
counterexample.premise_check: T_E is false on every assignment of weight at most 6, so phi agrees with CLIQUE on VA_0.
counterexample.conclusion_failure: The DNF term <E,empty> has E subseteq C_f, so C_f belongs to AC^n(phi).

load_bearing_failure: The published proof silently needs every positive DNF support accepted by a negative test to have size at most binom(k,2). No such bound follows from AC^n.

new_gate.name: RESTRICTED_DOMAIN_SEMANTIC_TRANSFER
new_gate.rule: Agreement on assignments of weight at most s cannot imply absence of all accepted supports unless every relevant support is proved to have size at most s.

claim_boundary: The claimed P!=NP proof is rejected as presented.
This counterexample does not prove P=NP.
